title: Great guide, great tour, great food!
text: My friends and I really enjoyed our tapas tour with David - he shared a lot of interesting history about Triana and Seville at the beginning of our tour and then took us to some great tapas bars to sample some food we never would have thought to try! The overall experience was fantastic, and in addition to taking us on the tour, David gave us his number so we could ask him questions/advice/recommendations for the rest of our stay. Would thoroughly recommend!
author: emdCambridge
